data.text:
❗️🇵🇭 - A fire erupted Saturday evening in the densely packed Happyland slum in Tondo, Manila, Philippines, prompting urgent evacuations and escalating to a critical status as flames spread rapidly through the residential area. 

Officials reported no fatalities, missing persons, or injuries, though the exact cause remains under investigation, with authorities assessing damage to homes and infrastructure in the affected zone.

Barangay 105, known as Happyland, stands as one of Manila's most impoverished and overcrowded informal settlements, home to roughly 25,000 residents crammed into makeshift structures amid limited access to basic services like clean water and sanitation.
